sentences.en: Their marriage has been strained lately because of financial problems.
sentences.zh: 最近因为经济问题，他们的婚姻有些紧张。

sentences.en: His voice was strained from singing along at the concert.
sentences.zh: 他在演唱会上跟着唱，声音都有点沙哑了。

sentences.en: Did you keep the whey after you strained the yogurt?
sentences.zh: 你把酸奶strained后有没有保留乳清？

senses.zh: 紧张的；不友善的；经过滤的
